title: A Deep Dive Into the Tangent Category of Schemes
summary: In this largely expository paper we provide a deep and explicit exploration and exposition of the tangent structure on the category of schemes $\mathbf{Sch}_{/S}$ whose tangent functor $T(X) = T_{X/S}$ is the relative tangent scheme of Grothendieck described in \emph{Éléments de Géométrie Algébrique} 4. In particular we provide explicit descriptions of the ways that the bifibration of quasicoherent sheaves and bifbration of quesicoherent sheaves of algebras over schemes may be built from the ways in which the bifibrations of modules and commutative algebras over commutative rings interact.…
